def: Multiplication by a Hadamard matrix, an orthogonal matrix whose entries are all +1 or −1 up to a common scale factor, computable in n log n time.
practice: Quantization methods such as QuIP# and QuaRot, and NVIDIA's NVFP4 pretraining recipe, apply randomized Hadamard transforms to spread outliers across a block before rounding; it differs from the element-wise Hadamard product.
